## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still documents the old 30-second default, so users reading it get the wrong timeout; that should be fixed. The code change and its updated default test are consistent with each other.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update README.md:3 to state the 60-second default — With this change, a user who runs the CLI without `--timeout` gets a 60-second timeout, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." — Users and operators who rely on the README will expect half the actual timeout when tuning or diagnosing slow requests. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds, or refer to `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT`.
